nodes.notes: Runs once per week for adaptive procurement workflow review.

nodes.name: Changes Check If Company Policies Changed
nodes.notes: Detects policy version changes since last review.

nodes.name: Get Past Purchase Approval History
nodes.notes: 25 realistic mock procurement approval transactions. Finance intentionally slower.

nodes.name: Get Current Approval Steps
nodes.notes: Current sequential approval rules by amount band.

nodes.name: Get Company Buying Rules
nodes.notes: Active policies including mandatory Finance / Procurement Head controls.

nodes.name: Clean and Organize the Data
nodes.notes: Normalize transactions + approval events for analysis.

nodes.name: Find What Is Slowing Approvals
nodes.notes: Per-role metrics and bottleneckScore formula.

nodes.name: Score Overall Approval Performance
nodes.notes: Overall E2E metrics and optimizationNeeded flag.

nodes.name: Do We Need to Improve the Process?
nodes.notes: TRUE → AI optimization. FALSE → no-op notification.

nodes.name: No Change Needed — Stop Here
nodes.notes: Successful termination path when no optimization needed.

nodes.name: Prepare Information for AI
nodes.notes: Structured context for OpenAI — aggregated metrics, not raw dumps.

nodes.name: Use Demo AI or Real AI?
nodes.notes: TRUE = credential-free demo mock recommendation. FALSE = live OpenAI node (requires credentials).

nodes.name: Demo AI Suggestion (No Login Needed)
nodes.notes: Self-contained AI recommendation mock producing Finance PARALLELIZE proposal. Swap path off when live OpenAI credentials are configured.

nodes.name: Real AI Suggestion (OpenAI)
nodes.notes: Live OpenAI path. Attach OpenAI credentials, then set useMockAi=false in node 10. AI recommends only — never deploys.

nodes.name: Read AI Answer as Structured Data
nodes.notes: Strip markdown fences and JSON.parse. Fail closed on parse errors.

nodes.name: Check AI Suggestion Against Company Rules
nodes.notes: Deterministic policy/compliance validation (10 rules).

nodes.name: Is the AI Suggestion Safe to Use?
nodes.notes: TRUE → change proposal. FALSE → reject/notify.

nodes.name: Tell Team: AI Suggestion Rejected
nodes.notes: Log/notify why recommendation was rejected.

nodes.name: Create Change Request for Approval
nodes.notes: PENDING_APPROVAL proposal. Does not deploy.

nodes.name: Wait for Manager Approval
nodes.notes: POST JSON to resume URL: { "approvalStatus": "APPROVED"|"REJECTED", "approvedBy": "procurement-admin", "additionalApproval": "APPROVED" } (additionalApproval required when riskLevel=HIGH). No silent auto-approve.

nodes.name: Read Approve / Reject Answer
nodes.notes: Normalize webhook approval payload.

nodes.name: Did the Manager Approve?
nodes.notes: TRUE → versioned deploy. FALSE → human rejection notify.

nodes.name: Tell Team: Change Was Rejected
nodes.notes: Stakeholder notification for human rejection.

nodes.name: Create New Process Version (Keep Old One)
nodes.notes: Create vN+1 without overwriting previous version.

nodes.name: Apply the New Approval Process
nodes.notes: In-memory config update with rollback snapshot (DB-ready shape).

nodes.name: Did the Update Work?
nodes.notes: Guard against update failure before audit.

nodes.name: Tell Team: Update Failed
nodes.notes: Update failure path.

nodes.name: Save Change History Record
nodes.notes: Full change audit / change log.

nodes.name: Prepare Stakeholder Notification
nodes.notes: Prepares stakeholder notification payload (Slack/email-ready).

parameters.jsCode:
const data = $('Save Change History Record').first().json;
const proposal = data.proposal;
const rec = data.recommendation;
const audit = data.auditLog;
const store = data.workflowConfigurationStore;

const reduction = rec?.expectedImpact?.estimatedApprovalTimeReductionPercent ?? 'N/A';
const changeSummary = (rec?.changes || [])
  .map((c) => c.action + ': ' + (c.targetRoles || []).join(', ') + ' — ' + (c.reason || ''))
  .join('\n') || (store?.configuration?.diagram || 'See proposal');

const notificationMessage = [
  'Adaptive Procurement Workflow Update',
  '',
  'Workflow:',
  'Standard Procurement',
  '',
  'Previous Version:',
  audit.oldVersion,
  '',
  'New Version:',
  audit.newVersion,
  '',
  'Change:',
  changeSummary,
  '',
  'Reason:',
  audit.reason,
  '',
  'Expected improvement:',
  reduction + '% reduction in approval time.',
  '',
  'Compliance:',
  'No mandatory controls removed.',
  '',
  'Risk:',
  String(audit.riskLevel || '').toUpperCase(),
  '',
  'AI Confidence:',
  Math.round(Number(audit.aiConfidence || 0) * 100) + '%',
  '',
  'Approved By:',
  audit.approvedBy,
  '',
  'Change ID:',
  audit.changeId,
  '',
  'Rollback:',
  'Previous version ' + audit.oldVersion + ' preserved and available.'
].join('\n');

return [{
  json: {
    status: 'COMPLETED',
    workflowId: audit.workflowId,
    changeId: audit.changeId,
    oldVersion: audit.oldVersion,
    newVersion: audit.newVersion,
    primaryBottleneck: data.primaryBottleneck,
    auditLog: audit,
    workflowConfigurationStore: store,
    notification: {
      channel: 'slack-or-email',
      to: ['user@example.com', 'user@example.com', 'user@example.com'],
      subject: 'Adaptive Procurement Workflow Update — ' + audit.oldVersion + ' → ' + audit.newVersion,
      message: notificationMessage
    },
    notifiedAt: new Date().toISOString()
  }
}];

parameters.content:
## Collect Review Inputs

This group starts the weekly review and gathers all needed information. It checks if company policies changed, then loads past purchase history, current approval steps, and buying rules. No process changes happen here yet.

## Analyze Performance and Decide

This group cleans the data and finds where approvals are slow. It scores overall performance and decides if improvement is needed. If no change is needed, the workflow stops here; if yes, it prepares information for AI.

## Get AI Suggestion and Check Rules

This group asks AI for a better approval process using demo AI or real OpenAI. Then it reads the AI answer clearly and checks it against company rules. AI only suggests ideas here and does not apply any live changes.

## Safety Decision and Manager Approval

This group decides if the AI suggestion is safe to use. If unsafe, the team is notified by message and email. If safe, a change request is created and the workflow waits for a manager to approve or reject.

## Apply Approved Change or Reject It

This group checks the manager’s decision. If approved, it creates a new process version, keeps the old one for rollback, and applies the update. If rejected, the team is informed and the old process stays the same.

## Confirm Update, Save History, and Notify

This group confirms whether the update worked. If successful, it saves the change history and notifies stakeholders. If the update fails or a change was rejected earlier, the team is alerted so nothing is missed.

# Adaptive Procurement Workflow Designer (Procurement Industry)

This workflow reviews purchase approvals every week. It looks at past requests, current approval steps, and company buying rules. Then it finds delays (often Finance) and asks AI for a better process that is both faster and still compliant.
AI only suggests changes. The system checks the suggestion against company rules, so required approvers cannot be removed. A manager must approve before anything goes live. If approved, a new version is saved (for example v3 → v4), the old version is kept for rollback, and the team is notified on Slack or email. If rejected, the current process stays unchanged.

## Setup steps
**1.** Import the workflow into n8n.
**2.** For testing, keep Demo AI on (no OpenAI login needed). For live AI, add OpenAI credentials and turn Demo AI off.
**3.** Connect Slack and/or Gmail credentials for team alerts.
**4.** Run Start Weekly Review or Run Review Now (Test).
**5.** When it pauses at Wait for Manager Approval, send Approve or Reject to the resume URL (Postman works).
**6.** Confirm the final result: new version created, history saved, and team notified.
